value.rationale: All-size exact global optimum on a canonical wheel family with a saturated hub and zero holds. Against the standard max-degree symmetric heuristic the performance loss diverges sharply as sqrt(2m/5), a structural and asymptotic discrepancy, not just a finite numerical gain. The conclusion has a plausible use as a benchmark for uniform-stationary reversible network design; no application performance claim is made.
